newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian shares fall in low volumes this week.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian shares fall in low volumes this week.

text.p: A total of four corporate issues traded on the Bulgarian stock market this week and all fell due to low investors' interest, brokers said on Friday.
TBS Hotels' three issues fell by 45, five and five levs to an all-time low of 80 levs against par of 1,000 on Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE).
The first issue fell by 36 percent from last trading on July 13.
Varna Grand Hotel shares fell by two levs to 83 levs against par of 100 on the BSE.
Total turnover amounted to 28,099 levs ($130) and traded volume was 341 stocks. There was no stock trading in August when the BSE was in summer recess.
Total weekly repo turnover rose to 5.717 million levs from 2.606 million levs the week before as investors preferred treasury issues to company shares because of their high yield and liquidity.
The 13-share Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index (RABSI) closed at an all-time low of 40.61 points, down 0.70 from last Friday, due to the fall of TBS Hotels.
* RABSI calculated on daily basis since February 1, 1994
